collection_routing.rule: the QC tool reports collection_complete = all primaries accounted AND usable >= target AND policy_violations empty; the runbook routes response freezing exclusively on collection_complete, never on raw target_met

empirical_power.correction: v6.1 called the unchanged v1 simulation a mild lower bound for the executed design; that claim was asserted, not demonstrated, and is RETRACTED
empirical_power.rule: tools/simulate_taew21_study_power_v2.py, frozen before its values are visible, executes the actual collection state machine (30 primaries with exclusion, sequential necessity-gated replacement activation in ID order, stop at first usable >= 486, exhaustion -> no authority) with the identical heterogeneity model and two-way cluster-robust analysis, and applies the analyzer's exact two-gate verdict (target met AND UCB <= 0.55); its empirical pass probabilities are recorded in artifacts/taew21-study-power.v2.json BEFORE recruitment; the operative usable-judgment target (486) and the verdict rule are unchanged

execution_binding.rule: the bundle builder validates this amendment (schema, protocol and power-v1 binding digests) and embeds its file digest in bundle-manifest.json as amendment_sha256; the QC tool and the analyzer require the supplied amendment file to match that manifest digest, making the bundle and every authoritative decision cryptographically attributable to the v6/v6.1/v6.2 chain

primary_completeness.defect_corrected: the all-primaries-first check ran only when replacements were present, so a response set with 27 of 30 primaries could reach 486 usable judgments and receive an authoritative GO, contradicting the v6.1 rule that the primary cohort is always collected in full
primary_completeness.rule: authoritative analysis requires every primary slot P00-P29 to be accounted for: a submitted session, or an entry in withdrawn_participants or duplicate_participants; the analyzer hard-errors otherwise, independent of replacement presence or the usable-judgment count
primary_completeness.slot_semantics: P-slots and R-slots are schedule slots, not people: a recruit who never starts is re-slotted to the same ID; withdrawn/duplicate entries account for a slot without contributing judgments

title: Primary-cohort completeness enforcement, fail-closed collection routing, amendment execution binding, empirical state-machine power
